findings.title: Playlist date unvalidated: User can write/delete arbitrary *.json via path traversal; short date panics
findings.impact: Any channel User writes JSON-shaped files or deletes any .json the process can reach (other channels, logo marks); date without two '-' panics the request task

findings.title: Rate limiter runs before RealIpLayer/GrantsLayer: spoofable or shared IP key, authenticated bypass never applies
findings.impact: Behind no proxy all clients share one bucket (3/min on /auth/ can lock everyone out); X-Forwarded-For rotation bypasses login/verify limits

findings.title: Panic in run_channel kills supervisor silently; is_alive stays true, no restart or alarm
findings.impact: Channel goes off air with no restart until an operator notices

findings.title: process_control busy flag racy (load then store) and not cancellation-safe; client disconnect can wedge channel
findings.impact: Dropped Restart after stop leaves channel off air and every later command returns 409 until process restart (handler-drop behaviour NOT_VERIFIED)

findings.title: Mid-clip failure writes filler for the whole clip duration, not the remainder
findings.impact: Schedule slips by the elapsed part; a clip failing at 29/30 min airs ~30 extra min of black

findings.title: Single bad packet (send_packet ?) aborts clip or live session; receive_frame errors not distinguished
findings.impact: Corrupt packet ends a file clip (into filler) or forces a full live reconnect gap

findings.title: Docker/release workflows publish without depending on validate; published feature set never tested
findings.impact: A tag or main push can publish images/releases with failing tests

findings.title: Scheduled auto-update restarts container with no on-air guard (opt-in)
findings.impact: When enabled, daily restart interrupts live output

findings.title: Failed schedule update returns early before invalidate(); ticker keeps stale events
findings.impact: Old time/content keeps airing although API changed the event

findings.title: Occurrence marked seen before claim; transient DB error drops it permanently
findings.impact: Scheduled break/live silently never airs, no run row

findings.title: DST spring-forward silently skips Media events in the gap
findings.impact: Media event at 02:30 on spring-forward day never airs, no status

findings.title: Error from a scheduled event tears down and restarts the whole playout
findings.impact: Output restart instead of fallback to programme (which errors are Err NOT_VERIFIED)

findings.title: Pacing clock never re-anchors after a stall: unthrottled burst catch-up
findings.impact: Receivers get faster-than-real-time bursts after any stall

findings.title: No hardware-encoder fallback; VAAPI device hard-wired
findings.impact: Missing/busy GPU means the channel does not start

findings.title: Live reader permits can wedge (2 per input) until process restart; fixed 1s retry
findings.impact: Stalled clients can permanently disable a live input (interrupt behaviour NOT_VERIFIED)

findings.title: SCTE-35 injector fails open: one bad sync byte stops all signalling, no return/cancel
findings.impact: Downstream can stay out-of-network if it relies on explicit return

findings.title: 2FA /auth/verify has no attempt limit or lockout
findings.impact: With the password, 6-digit code brute-forceable in 5 min given F-002

findings.title: ChannelAdmin can set custom output URL to a local file path
findings.impact: FFmpeg writes media bytes to arbitrary writable path, e.g. the DB

findings.title: Console request log records full URIs incl. access/key/uuid secrets
findings.impact: File tokens, logo control key and SSE uuid leak into logs

findings.title: Playlist import writes user-named file in shared temp dir; no cleanup on error
findings.impact: User can overwrite/delete temp-dir files; concurrent imports race

findings.title: config_global init trigger+insert not atomic, CREATE TRIGGER without IF NOT EXISTS
findings.impact: Interrupted first start can fail every later start

findings.title: create_channel_records deferred transaction reads before writing (SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT)
findings.impact: Concurrent channel creation or creation during writes returns 500

findings.title: Deleting a channel cascades away its as-run history
findings.impact: Broadcast evidence log destroyed with the channel (design decision to confirm)

findings.title: No backup/snapshot before migrations or self-update; forward-only migrations
findings.impact: Failed upgrade has no rollback path

findings.title: Critical-path test gaps: SCTE-35 integration, DST fall-back, restart, migration upgrade fixtures, 401/403 matrix
findings.impact: Regressions in on-air paths not caught by CI

findings.title: Container runs as root with no healthcheck or health route
findings.impact: Hung process never restarted

findings.title: Unpinned base images, mixed action majors, untagged watchtower with docker socket
findings.impact: Non-reproducible builds; supply-chain exposure

findings.title: Released-migration immutability not provable (no tags/checksum gate)
findings.impact: Checksum mismatch possible for intermediate-build users

findings.title: Migration 00003 INNER JOIN copies can drop orphan legacy rows
findings.impact: Legacy pre-00003 data only

findings.title: Graceful shutdown does not drain HTTP/SSE
findings.impact: In-flight requests cut on restart

findings.title: Logs rotate daily without a size cap
findings.impact: Disk exhaustion from verbose faults

findings.title: Manual trigger unbounded/duplicable; plain User may trigger and stop events
findings.impact: Duplicate interrupting events; policy question

findings.title: SSE broadcaster does serial per-client work, no client cap
findings.impact: Many clients delay status for all

findings.title: Role/channel/password changes not applied to live sessions (JWT claims trusted; refresh not revoked)
findings.impact: Demoted/removed user keeps access up to token expiry; refresh survives password change

findings.title: Setup endpoint unauthenticated until first-run completes; port published on all interfaces
findings.impact: First-run takeover if exposed before setup
